name: Probably Nothing
storyline: Probably Nothing is named as it is because when I was young I had board games, toy's etc, but what I didn't have is friends. When you have friends, you can say "what will you do with your friends?" and the most common answer is probably nothing. So I want not only myself, but everyone to play this game. To bring your friends, or make new ones. And when you are asked, what are you and your friends going to do today, you can confidently say, "Probably Nothing." And you will smile and laugh and enjoy eachother.
summary: In Probably Nothing, you're just an ordinary streamer who's been whisked away from their gaming setup to... somewhere else entirely! As you explore this strange new world, discover that your home has been replaced by a wacky labrynth filled with cryptic clues and hidden passages.
